description_html:
This large one bedroom flat (Type 20) is on the 6th floor of Defoe House, Barbican with aspect over the residents' garden and of the City skyline and St Paul's.

This flat requires some refurbishment and is sold chain free.

Defoe House is superbly located seconds from the Barbican Arts Centre and lakeside terrace. The restaurants, bars, shops and amenities of Smithfield and Farringdon are also a short walk away. Barbican (Elizabeth, Circle, Metropolitan, Hammersmith & City) is the closest station.

Residents facilities and services: full use of the private Barbican gardens; storage lockers and parking are available by separate arrangement; collection of rubbish and recycling from your door; cycle parking; 24 hour car park porterage; tennis courts (small fee applies); proximity of the world renowned Barbican Arts Centre with its concert hall, cinema screens, theatre, galleries, library, shops, bars and restaurants.

Managed by the City of London Corporation, the Barbican Estate is the finest achievement of the architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon. It was Grade II listed in 2001 in recognition of its extraordinary contribution to London's urban landscape.

Council tax - City of London, Band E, £1,557 PA.
Service charge: TBC
To be sold with extended lease
Underfloor heating is included within the service charge.
Chain free
